d: Every product needs a caretaker who takes it from design and development to an anticipated audience with the same amount of sweat, love, and attention that has gone into it for several months behind the scenes. Today, we are searching for a Customer Acquisition Specialist who can help us take Mamo to those who need it.

Sales is about communicating a promise to people through honesty and empathy. It is the first human interaction between Mamo Business and those whose problems it will solve. It’s a chance to inform, inspire, and change a region and culture for the better, and it involves very little in the way of shouting or yelling but rather showing and serving. It’s a unique opportunity to connect people to products that will give them back their time and peace of mind.
Ready to take on the challenge? Read on and apply below.
Take charge of our inbound sales queue, efficiently handling incoming inquiries from potential customers.
Effectively manage and update the sales pipeline CRM systems, including Pipedrive and Apollo.
Ask insightful questions to determine how our products or services can effectively address their challenges and goals.
Conduct virtual product demonstrations and presentations to showcase the value and benefits of our offerings.
Develop a deep understanding of Mamo’s product offerings, enabling you to tailor solutions to match the unique requirements of potential customers.
Utilize your strong sales skills to guide potential customers through the sales process, addressing any objections or concerns.
Lead the inbound sales process from beginning to end with a consultative approach, leveraging Mamo’s Sales Playbook.
Share insights from customer engagements with the product team and sales leadership.
You possess 2+ years of experience in direct sales.
You have experience in B2B Sales.
You have exceptional English written and verbal communication skills.
You possess an innate ability for organization and structure, such that these skills come as second nature to you.
You have exceptional skills and proficiency in CRM and tools (like Pipedrive and Apollo).
You enjoy multitasking and working in a fast-paced environment.
You have a good understanding of the sales process and an ability to drive conversations with customers.
Startup environment that’s big on individual responsibility and leans on process and automation.
We’re big on culture. Work with stunning, supportive product, design, and engineering teams on problems that matter.
You will be learning and growing all of the time. From business, product, and design to engineering, you will be learning from a world-class team that is caring, kind, and empathetic.

Mamo has the potential for a wide-reaching impact. Mamo is taking on the challenge of bringing about a new era of financial inclusion that begins close to home by providing access and experiences that make sense. That means you will never be bored.

The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

This key role focuses on a Well Log Data Management project utilizing AspenTech’s proprietary software for Formation Evaluation and Characterization. This project emphases mainly on maintaining high-quality well logs data in a repository, preparing composite logs and the utilization of spliced logs in advanced geological workflows e.g., to estimate the Total Organic Carbon (TOC) from wireline logs using different methodologies etc. As a trusted advisor, you will work closely with the customers to understand their specific challenges and provide innovative solutions that drive long-term value and success. This position offers an exciting opportunity to make a direct and expressive impact on both the customers’ achievements and AspenTech’s continued growth in the region.

Reporting to the Director of Customer Enablement (On-Sites - SSE), the Sr Principal Customer Enablement Specialist – Petrophysicist will be responsible for delivering full-time, on-site support to one of AspenTech’s most strategic customers in the Middle East.
r: Provide customer support service on a Well Log Data Management project utilizing AspenTech’s proprietary software for Formation Evaluation and Characterization that drives user engagement and sustains product usage.
Oversee and ensure the quality and consistency of well log data (field data, processed data, and interpreted data).
Review and ensure technical accuracy and consistency of petrophysical work produced by Petrophysicist.
Manage petrophysical aspects of the project, ensuring timely delivery of results and alignment with project objectives.
Ensure the quality of well log data through detailed review and validation and discussion with data providers.
Apply the latest technology and efficient workflows to generate petrophysical work processes.
Evaluate and normalize field wide petrophysical data (where required).
Generate final composite logs for all wells and prepare final LAS files containing all well log attributes.
Assist with troubleshooting of technical and/or petrophysical data related problems described by Customer using AspenTech’s proprietary software.
Prepare and present technical reports, presentations, and recommendations to senior management and Customers.
Adhere to contractual obligations and communicate potential gaps to management.
Collaborate with other AspenTech functions to maintain and develop business opportunities.
Develop strong relationships with Customer, building an understanding of their business needs and challenges.
Work in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Customer on the Well Log Data Management project to ensure effective coordination and successful delivery of project activities.
Support the Project Manager and Customer in maintaining well data for newly drilled wells and integrating new data for existing wells into the repository.
Preparation of composite logs for analysis and interpretation.
Utilize available spliced logs in advanced geological workflows, such as estimating Total Organic Carbon (TOC) using various methodologies.
Work with the Customer to troubleshoot and resolve any other issues related to the Well Log Data Management project.
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Petrophysics, Geology, Geosciences, Earth Sciences or related discipline.
A minimum of 15 years of industry experience as a Petrophysicist, Well log Analyst or Wellsite Geologist in the oil and gas industry.
Extensive experience in petrophysical evaluation, well logging techniques, reservoir characterization, and resource assessment.
Good understanding of Petrophysical topics like NMR, ECS, XRD, PNL, SONIC, TOC calculations etc.
Preferably have experience in well log data management (Well log conditioning, Splicing, QA/QC etc.).
Ability to work with large datasets, perform quality control, and ensure data integrity.

Proven hands-on experience with AspenTech Formation Evaluation software (Aspen Geolog) and/or other advanced petrophysical applications such as PowerLog, Techlog, DecisionSpace Petrophysics, or Interactive Petrophysics.
Any previous experience of information and / or document management system is a plus.
Experience in advanced well log data analysis from various sources such as Wireline, Logging While Drilling, Measurement While Drilling and Cased hole logs is a plus.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to resolve complex technical issues and capability to prioritize tasks.
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, to convey complex technical concepts to a variety of audience.
Ability to identify opportunities that create value for customers with a strong customer first mindset.
Ability to proactively take the lead in resolving complex technical issues and/or difficult organisational problems with an innovative approach.
Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and competing priorities.
